title: Gold Prices to Rise Amid Fed Rate Hikes and Iran Tensions
summary: The gold market is expected to rise due to the Federal Reserve's rate hikes and tensions between the US and Iran. The Fed's decision to raise interest rates has led to a surge in oil prices, which could impact the price of gold. Meanwhile, the ongoing tensions between the US and Iran have raised concerns about potential conflicts that could affect global markets.
summary_points: The Federal Reserve is expected to raise interest rates this week, leading to a surge in oil prices.
title_hi: सोने की कीमतें फेड रेट हाइक्स और ईरान तनाव के बाद बढ़ सकती हैं

summary_points_hi: फेड रेट हाइक्स ने तेल की कीमतों में वृद्धि की।

framing.right: Right-leaning outlets focus on the potential for conflicts between the US and Iran to affect global markets and the impact of rising oil prices on gold prices.
